import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return (params[0]*np.sqrt(v)
            + params[1]*t**params[2]
            + params[3]*x**params[4]*np.cos(params[5]*v)
            + params[6]*np.exp(params[7]*t)*x**params[8]
            + params[9]*v)
